_about: Public-domain Stephen Grellet (1773-1855), the French-born American Quaker minister who travelled Europe and Russia, for the Word Hoard: the Memoirs of his Life and Gospel Labours, drawn from his own journals and edited by Benjamin Seebohm, in the first American edition (Philadelphia, 1860) and the second London edition (1861), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
